h1: Valentin Motors Madrid. Porsche specialist workshop since 1979
secciones: Valentin Motors Madrid. Porsche specialist workshop since 1979
Valentin Motors Madrid is a fully independent Porsche specialist workshop; in 2024 we completed forty-five years of service.
At Valentin Madrid we are Porsche people like you. We look after your car in our fully equipped premises of more than 2,500 m².

Our purpose: “We bring together tradition and innovation to lead the restoration of classic Porsche and of the 911 across every generation, with a boldness that keeps us working at what we care about.”
Services
At Valentin Motors Madrid we offer a full Porsche service that covers:
• Servicing. See our fixed prices by model.
• Repairs. Our technicians specialise in air-cooled classic engines and in current water-cooled ones.
• Full or partial restorations.
• Personalisation and upgrades.
• Backdating and restomods.
• Track preparation. We prepare your Porsche for the circuit, whether for the odd session or to compete in a championship.
• Motorsport. We are your technical team at the track. We have been competing since 1979.
• We organise track days with the Valentin community. Come along.
• Buying and selling used Porsche. We select, test and prepare the best cars on the market, and offer them at the right price with a 12-month warranty.
The Valentin Motors team
The Valentin Motors Madrid team is made up of two engineers and specialist technicians in engine work, with extensive Porsche experience.
We have two distinct teams: one for classics and restoration, the other specialising in youngtimers and current models.
Original parts and leading-brand components
We are an authorised distributor and installer for the German firm TECHART.
We also work regularly with components from leading names: KW and Bilstein suspension; Michelin tyres; AP Racing brakes and clutches; PFC brakes; Heigo roll cages and a long list of top suppliers.
Everything we offer our customers has been thoroughly tested and assessed by the Valentin team as part of our research and development work.
